items.english: Illustrative estimate: cash income plus unmatched harvest at an assumed R15/kg. Not revenue, profit or measured household benefit.
items.draft: Isiqikelelo somzekelo: ingeniso yemali kunye nesivuno esingahambelaniyo nentengiso ngexabiso eliqikelelweyo le-R15/kg. Ayiyo ingeniso, inzuzo okanye ingeniso yekhaya elinganisiweyo.
items.backtranslation: ...Not income, profit or estimated household income.
items.problem: 'measured household benefit' became 'estimated household income' (a money claim).
items.corrected: Isiqikelelo somzekelo: ingeniso yemali kunye nesivuno esingahambelaniyo nentengiso ngexabiso eliqikelelweyo le-R15/kg. Ayiyo ingeniso, inzuzo okanye uncedo olulinganisiweyo lwekhaya.

items.english: Weighted across the 5 setup steps, so the percentage is not simply steps done ÷ steps total.
items.draft: Kubalwe kumanyathelo okuseta ama-5, ngoko ipesenti ayingomanyathelo agqityiweyo ÷ onke amanyathelo.
items.backtranslation: Counted out of 5 setup steps, so percent is completed steps / all steps.
items.problem: 'Weighted' lost; also reads as a plain count.
items.corrected: Ibalwa ngokubaluleka kwenyathelo ngalinye kumanyathelo okuseta ama-5, ngoko ipesenti ayingomanyathelo agqityiweyo ÷ onke amanyathelo ngokulula.

items.english: {n} months to {month} {year}. Bars are dated ledger entries only — a gap is a month with no entry, not a month of no work.
items.draft: Iinyanga ezi-{n} ukuya ku-{month} {year}. Imivalo ibonisa kuphela iingeniso zeencwadi ezinomhla — isikhewu yinyanga engenayo ingeniso, ayiyo inyanga engasetyenzwanga.
items.backtranslation: Bars show only incomes of dated books - a gap is a month with no income
items.problem: Chart is money in AND out; 'entries' narrowed to 'incomes'.
items.corrected: Iinyanga ezi-{n} ukuya ku-{month} {year}. Imivalo ibonisa kuphela amanqaku ezincwadi ezinomhla — isikhewu yinyanga engenanto irekhodiweyo, ayiyo inyanga engasetyenzwanga.

items.english: A plan is visible, but it has no verified crop-cycle kilogram benchmark. Missing evidence is not a 0 kg target.
items.draft: Isicwangciso siyabonakala, kodwa asinawo umlinganiselo wekhilogram wesangqa sezityalo ovavanyiweyo. Ubungqina obulahlekileyo asisiyo injongo ye-0 kg.
items.backtranslation: Missing evidence ['asisiyo' = the plan] is not a 0 kg goal.
items.problem: Concord 'asisiyo' points at plan, not evidence (ubungqina).
items.corrected: Isicwangciso siyabonakala, kodwa asinawo umlinganiselo wekhilogram wesangqa sezityalo ovavanyiweyo. Ubungqina obulahlekileyo abuyonjongo ye-0 kg.

items.english: No chart is drawn rather than an invented one.
items.draft: Akukho chathi itsalwayo kunokuba kwenziwe eyenziweyo.
items.backtranslation: No drawn chart rather than a made one that was made.

items.english: The site survey has not been started. All {total} questions are blank — this is a gap in the record, not a score of zero.
items.draft: Uphando lwendawo aluqalwanga. Yonke imibuzo engu-{total} ayiphendulwanga — esi sisikhewu kwirekhodi, ayiyo isikolo se-zero.
items.corrected: Uphando lwendawo aluqalwanga. Yonke imibuzo engu-{total} ayiphendulwanga — esi sisikhewu kwirekhodi, ayiyo inqaku elingu-zero.

items.english: Treat the {n} blank answer as unknown. Do not read them as a low score.
items.draft: Jonga impendulo engenanto engu-{n} njengengaziwayo. Ize ungayifundi njengesikolo esiphantsi.
items.backtranslation: Don't read it as a low 'school'.
items.corrected: Jonga impendulo engenanto engu-{n} njengengaziwayo. Ize ungayifundi njengenqaku eliphantsi.

items.english: Treat the {n} blank answers as unknown. Do not read them as a low score.
items.draft: Jonga iimpendulo ezingenanto ezi-{n} njengezingaziwayo. Zize ungazifundi njengesikolo esiphantsi.
items.backtranslation: Don't read them as a low 'school'.
items.corrected: Jonga iimpendulo ezingenanto ezi-{n} njengezingaziwayo. Zize ungazifundi njengamanqaku aphantsi.

items.english: {n} more farmer is enrolled here but have not agreed to share their figures, so they are not listed.
items.draft: Omnye umfama ({n}) ubhalisiwe apha kodwa akavumanga ukwabelana ngezibalo zakhe, ngoko akaphawulwanga kuluhlu.
items.problem: 'not listed' became 'not marked' (consent/privacy; farmer might still be listed).
items.corrected: Omnye umfama ({n}) ubhalisiwe apha kodwa akavumanga ukwabelana ngezibalo zakhe, ngoko akabhalwanga kuluhlu.

items.english: {n} more farmers are enrolled here but have not agreed to share their figures, so they are not listed.
items.draft: Abanye abafama abangu-{n} babhalisiwe apha kodwa abavumanga ukwabelana ngezibalo zabo, ngoko abaphawulwanga kuluhlu.
items.corrected: Abanye abafama abangu-{n} babhalisiwe apha kodwa abavumanga ukwabelana ngezibalo zabo, ngoko ababhalwanga kuluhlu.
